thread:
Maya Patel: Quick check-in re: onboarding Gaia-Large-v2 with EdgeWave + NorthGrid + cloud marketplaces. We need to lock license form, telemetry/telemetry opt-out, and artifact formats. Can we run a short decision thread?
Ravi Desai: I can take marketplace gating. Question: marketplaces typically disallow custom opt-out checkboxes; we might need to bake telemetry opt-out into the runtime.
Nina Gomez: EdgeWave wants telemetry disabled by default on their appliances and a signed manifest proving no phoning-home. They'll accept an opt-in toggle only for diagnostics.
Paul Zheng: From infra side, runtime can embed a compile-time flag to disable telemetry and produce a no-telemetry build. That build would have a signed manifest asserting telemetry=false. But that increases our build variants.
Sasha (Legal): Licensing thoughts: partner distribution of quantized artifacts is ok with a partner-limited redistribution clause. I'm pushing back on partners requesting the ability to make derivative checkpoints available. Also need an explicit clause about telemetry: "Partner must not re-enable telemetry or modify provenance without Redwood written consent."
Tori (PM): Timeline constraint: EdgeWave marketing wants the product visible in marketplace catalogs by 2024-06-10. That gives us ~3 weeks. We should prioritize an initial "no-telemetry" quantized bundle for marketplaces and an alternate "telemetry-enabled" dev-only image for SI testing.
Maya Patel: Agree. Action split: Ravi = marketplace acceptance & SKU, Nina = EdgeWave hw spec + manifest requirements, Paul = runtime build variants + signed manifests, Sasha = license + telemetry clause, Tori = roadmap & PR gating.
Ravi Desai: Marketplace nuance: some clouds require a single downloadable artifact; others allow marketplace to link to a vendor page. For the ones requiring artifact upload, we must ensure the package size and encryption are acceptable. Also, we may have to provide a simple EULA text box on their form. I'll map per-marketplace requirements and post a short list.
Nina Gomez: EdgeWave kernel note: they want a list of supported operator kernels and a fallback software kernel. They'll ship on two SKUs of appliances: v1 (older) and v2 (new). For v1 we should guarantee a reduced-performance profile. Need to decide whether to include both kernel bundles in the marketplace artifact or to provide them via an authenticated partner download.
Paul Zheng: Prefer authenticated partner download for smaller marketplace payloads. Marketplace often complains about giant tarballs (>10GB). We can put core quantized model in the artifact and link kernel-optimizations via a partner-access URL in the manifest. Manifest will be signed.
Sasha (Legal): That plan is acceptable but add clause: "Authenticated downloads for partner-specific optimizations require partner-level credentials and are governed by the addendum." Also include export control checkbox and a prohibition on sharing manifests without signature.
Tori (PM): For PR we need to coordinate embargo. EdgeWave legal flagged that any mention of "on-device weights" must be cleared. If we phrase as "on-premise runtime bundles optimized for EdgeWave appliances" it might be safer. Ben from marketing will want exact phrasing.
Maya Patel: Noted. Sasha, can you add a brief marketing-safe blurb in the addendum so we have approved language for marketplaces and PR?
Sasha (Legal): Yes. I'll add a short approved blurb and a logo usage appendix. Also including a simple consent workflow: partners must confirm they will not redistribute raw checkpoints when registering artifact.
Ravi Desai: Marketplace SKU suggestion: GAIA-LG-V2-RW-EDGE-1.0 with short description "Quantized Gaia-Large-v2 (q4_8) packaged with Redwood runtime; no telemetry; signed provenance." I'll draft SKU proposals for AWS, GCP, and Azure.
Paul Zheng: Build plan: two artifacts: gaia-q4_8-no-telemetry.tar.gz (marketplace) and gaia-q4_8-dev-with-telemetry.tar.gz (SI sandbox). Both will have manifest.json and signature. I'll include provenance fields: build_id, sha256, build_time.
Nina Gomez: EdgeWave wants the signed manifest to include a hardware-compatibility matrix and kernel hash. Can the manifest schema include a kernels[] array?
Paul Zheng: Yes. Manifest will be JSON with fields but we'll include it only as a signed text blob (not nested in this Slack JSON).
deploy-bot: Created artifact pipeline: gaia-q4-no-telemetry-20240518 build queued.
Maya Patel: Risk note: If a partner demands redistribution rights for raw weights, we return to legal and escalate. For now, we keep distribution scoped to packaged, quantized artifacts. Sasha, set a policy for exception requests.
Sasha (Legal): Will create an exception workflow: technical review, export-control check, elevated indemnity and SLA, and exec approval. Draft by 2024-05-21.
Ravi Desai: I'll open marketplace tickets today and flag the EULA language field. Will ping here with marketplace checklist per vendor.
Tori (PM): I'll compile these decisions into the product brief and share. Next sync Friday 05-23 to confirm build artifacts and legal sign-off.
Maya Patel: Thanks everyone. Keeping this as the single source of truth for decisions. -- Maya
